name: Toggle Editable Fields
description: It provides a toggle formatter to edit fields in it view representation for Boolean field type.
project_description:
Synopsis 
 Toggle Editable fields is a formatter to transform "classic" boolean field formatter to toggle editable field directly on 'view' display or on views lists.

 Requirements 
 Drupal 8 .

 Bootstrap Toggle Plugin 

 How to install 
 
 Download this module 
 Download Bootstrap Toggle Plugin and place it in the libraries folder (named `bootstrap-toggle`) or use bower if you are composer user. 
 Install `toggle_editable_fields` the usual way .
 Create a boolean field 
 On display choose `Toggle Editable Formatter` formatter and configure settings as you want. 
 
 You can now switch the state of your field in every place (view/entity view etc...)
